phase: M4 third screen: validation selection aligned with independent and incremental multi-metric objectives
reuse: All existing11 corrector types per family per fold, trained on the same audited source OOF; no new labels or GP fits
aggregation: Compute each validation cell metric, then equal-domain means

policies.balanced: Minimize mean relative metric to corresponding uncorrected parent over2 endpoints x3 metrics
policies.constrained: Require none of the6 validation endpoint metrics exceeds its parent by more than1e-12 SOH; among eligible configs minimize same balanced objective, with identity fallback

selection: Shared family/type/gain for all8 parent combinations per fold; ties prefer lower gain then family/key. Report both global policies without datasetwise mixing.
controls: Retain previous plain/anchored MAE-only selection results and constant controls
limits: Motivated after2 failed development screens, not independent preregistration
Validation nonregression does not imply held-domain nonregression
No M4 adoption unless actual all-dataset ablation and stability requirements pass
